What zutempo was built against

Source: R/info.R
zutempo_info.Rd

The versions and pins that decide zutempo's behaviour: the package and zufast versions, whether the 128-bit arithmetic uses the compiler's __int128, and the commits of the Temporal specification and of test262 the package follows, with the tzdata release its fixtures come from. The pins live in inst/spec/PINS and move only on purpose.

Usage

zutempo_info()

Value

A list of class zutempo_info with elements package, zufast, int128, spec_repository, spec_commit, spec_date, test262_repository, test262_commit, test262_date, tzdata, tzdir, tz_version, tz_form and tz_links_version.

Details

The time zone fields describe the database zutempo reads (design 8): tzdir, the directory found by base R's lookup order (NA when none exists), tz_version, the tzdata release it declares, tz_form, whether its files carry explicit transitions far into the future ("fat") or stop at the last rule change ("slim"), and tz_links_version, the tzdata release the built-in link table comes from.

Examples

zutempo_info()
#> zutempo 0.0.0.9000
#>   zufast 0.1.0, 128-bit arithmetic: __int128
#>   specification: tc39/proposal-temporal@e8cc03fc970a (2026-07-27)
#>   test262: tc39/test262@d53ebc8b1931 (2026-10-13)
#>   tzdata pin: 2026d; link table: 2026d
#>   tz database: /usr/share/zoneinfo (2026c, fat)
